data: Tesla reported **GAAP diluted EPS of $2.04 for fiscal 2024**, down from **$4.30 in fiscal 2023**, a **decline of about 52.6%**. **Net income attributable to common stockholders for fiscal 2024 was about $7.09 billion**, compared with roughly $15.0 billion in fiscal 2023. Including noncontrolling interests, fiscal 2024 net income was about $7.15 billion. Much of the drop came from a one-time benefit in 2023: Tesla released a deferred tax valuation allowance worth about $5.9 billion, which inflated that year's earnings. Lower vehicle average selling prices and compressed margins in 2024 also contributed. These figures are from memory of Tesla's 10-K filings, so check them against the filing before you rely on them.
